items.title: Joel Dorn interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2007
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I love — sometimes there are certain songs if you’re in — you can pan things from left to right, like Frankie Valli, the Four Seasons records. >> [INTERVIEWEE] Oh Bob Crewe.

ctx.x: I love — sometimes there are certain songs if you’re in — you can pan things from left to right, like Frankie Valli, the Four Seasons records.
You know, they mixed all the vocals on one side and it’s really cool to like turn the thing back and forth and listen to how that was put together. I love that stuff.
